description: This line plot illustrates the progression of next-token prediction accuracy for two experimental runs, labeled “Ex1 Accuracy” and “Ex2 Accuracy,” over training steps, as part of the RedWhale Korean LLM continual pretraining study. The x-axis, labeled “Step,” spans from 0 to 600,000 in linear increments of 100,000, with major gridlines at each 100,000-step interval. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (Next Token Prediction),” ranges from 0.10 to 0.40 in increments of 0.05, also on a linear scale. The “Ex1 Accuracy” line, rendered in solid blue with circular markers, begins near 0.10 at step 0, rises sharply to approximately 0.39 by step 100,000, and then gradually increases to about 0.41 by step 600,000, showing a plateau after 400,000 steps. The “Ex2 Accuracy” line, shown in solid teal with circular markers, starts at 0.09 at step 0, jumps to 0.27 by step 50,000, then climbs steadily to 0.37 by step 200,000, and continues to rise more slowly, reaching approximately 0.385 by step 600,000. Both lines exhibit rapid initial gains followed by diminishing returns, with Ex1 consistently outperforming Ex2 across all measured steps.
